entities.summary: Ramkhamhaeng, commonly known as Pho Khun Ramkhamhaeng the Great, was the third king of the Phra Ruang dynasty, ruling the Sukhothai Kingdom—a historical polity in what is now Thailand—from 1279 to 1298, during its most prosperous era.
